verdict.rationale: Anrok's API covers core tax workflows (customers, certificates, tax calculation, filings, transactions, product mapping) and is positioned as 'headless tax' powering the same engine as the UI, suggesting broad parity. However, some UI-highlighted features (registration threshold tracking, world exposure dashboard, automatic filing/payment execution) are only described as UI/dashboard features without explicit corresponding API endpoints in the evidence, and openapi.json/llms.txt probes 404, weakening confidence in full machine-readable API completeness. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for registration automation and filing/payment execution, working openapi.json/llms.txt spec discoverable, independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
